---
title: "National Partnerships"
---

Partnerships in Türkiye support ÇAHSPAR’s international mission by connecting local expertise with comparative research and global academic exchange. We seek to work with universities, research centres, public bodies, workers’ and employers’ organisations and civil society as contributors to international research questions.

## Connecting Expertise with International Cooperation

- Develop joint proposals that connect researchers in Türkiye with international consortia
- Contribute contextual knowledge and carefully documented evidence to comparative studies
- Support co-authored publications and participation in international research networks
- Create opportunities for early-career researchers to work with collaborators abroad
- Discuss international findings with practitioners and assess their relevance to Türkiye’s institutional context

## Reciprocal Knowledge Exchange

We aim to make research from Türkiye more accessible internationally while bringing insights from other societies into dialogue with researchers and practitioners in Türkiye. These partnerships form part of a wider programme of research across regions.
